The day of the event race. Shinko Windy 
had endured rigorous training just for 
today. And now, the long-awaited race 
begins—

However, things don't go as planned and 
she's on the verge of losing. If this 
continues, her "ambition" will be crushed— 
Without thinking, she ends up biting 
another runner.

Fortunately, the opponent was unharmed. 
However, this "biting incident" quickly 
became known all across Japan.

Later, a deeply remorseful Shinko Windy 
sincerely apologized to the one she had 
bitten, promising never to bite anyone 
during a race again.

The next goal is the graded stakes race, 
the "Unicorn S." Regaining her composure, 
she decided to give it her all.
